reason: Both make essentially the same unsupported proposal: an M3 nozzle-specific 300–350 mm optimum cannot be assumed for the i7 and is geometrically incompatible with deposition inside a 120 mm internal diameter; moreover, particle velocity does not necessarily increase with stand-off distance. A’s cited evidence addresses oxidation generally rather than spray-distance optimization, while B cites no support, so neither adequately grounds or tests the required intervention.
